title: Beyond the Numbers
text:
Aloha, I’m Kent, born and raised on the island of O’ahu. I’m currently attending Chaminade University pursuing my Bachelor of Science in Data Science with a minor in Business Administration.
I’m also interning with the U.S department of Defense under the U.S Army Pacific (USARPAC). I’m gaining hands-on experience in data analytics, business intelligence and solving real-worlds problems.
I’ve been always obsessed with commercial aviation since I was a kid and with my current job, bookkeeping had grew an interest on me and sparked the idea of working with analytics with commercial aviation, preferably with Delta.
My current activity outside of academics is prepping for the upcoming JAL Honolulu Marathon starting this December! Honestly, I’ve slacking a bit but were getting back on track and reviving my health journey starting with gym/fitness.
Fun Fact: My favorite all time food is Pho and will forever vouch for it!
